[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]这样吧，使节团的各位先在城内随便逛逛，雅赛努斯风物无限，相信能让尊贵的客人们不虚此行。
[name="里底娅"]哦对了，或许您可以顺便去第一神殿的重建现场看看……你们送还的正是克瑞斯拉的旧物，也是一种缘分。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#6$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]米诺斯人爱好戏剧与哲学，我们享受谨严的编排与推敲，却也期待意外的惊喜。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]至于交换一事嘛，稍等两天，我会安排一场隆重的仪式。
[name="里底娅"]按米诺斯的传统，重要的场合应以祭司主导的一场戏剧开场，请众英雄庇佑万事顺利。
[name="里底娅"]不过，雅赛努斯在两年前新设理事官一职就是为了替神殿祭司们排忧解难，简化流程。所以我已经提前派人筹备了。
[name="里底娅"]在这期间，我会指派我可靠的助手、我的执笔人为您安排所有行程。有任何问题，您都可以让他解决……赫卡德墨！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$dooropenquite")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2070_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="赫卡德墨"]我在的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2070_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫卡德墨"]米诺斯的无名小辈，狂响的声筒，赫卡德墨，愿意为您效劳……只要在我的上班时间内。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2077_1#6$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2077_1#6$1",focus="l")]
[name="贝赫努"]呵呵。我用不着这种小白脸。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2070_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫卡德墨"]……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2077_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="l")]
[name="贝赫努"]我的意思是，舟车劳顿，我已经很累了，就在宾馆里等你们安排好交换仪式。
[name="贝赫努"]至于参观第一神殿的重建现场，这种有趣的活动我就不和真正的大使抢了。她干劲满满，还是个博物馆学家，会对此感兴趣的。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]如您所愿，贝赫努先生。我会让赫卡德墨直接去找梅捷缇克缇小姐。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2077_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="贝赫努"]里底娅理事官，我期待你的“惊喜”。
[name="贝赫努"]但——最好别让我发现你是在刻意拖延，或者另有所图。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]同样的话，我也想对您说，贝赫努先生。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2077_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="贝赫努"]……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]您推开窗往外看，特尔斐运河上的晨雾才刚散。这份宁静来之不易，愿我们都能以诚相待。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2067_1#6$1",focus="r")]
[name="里底娅"]说起来，今天没见到梅捷缇克缇大使，真可惜啊。如此年轻有为，却又如此随性……她究竟是个怎样的人呢？
[Dialog]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="69_g1_rivercrossing",screenadapt="coverall", block=true)]
[delay(time=2)]
[playMusic(key="$comedy_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="none")]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="缇缇"]哕——
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="米奥"]呃……拜托，你才把一只脚踏在了船舷上，有点出息好不好。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#7$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]（小声）船在晃。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="米奥"]船当然会晃。
[name="米奥"]你不是说自己在麦克斯特区读书的时候，还专门报名参加了学校的帆船社？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]（小声）专业课的活动太多了啦，不是在古籍修复室就是在考古现场，我、我最终就去了，两次。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2069_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]原来是哥伦比亚来的，看这身装扮，我还以为……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2069_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吕刻伊昂"]赞索斯老师。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]嗯？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2069_1#3$1",focus="l")]
[name="吕刻伊昂"]这位小姐晕船。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]很少见的现象。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]我、没、有。只是，只是走了太远的路太累了，脚一下子没踩到实地，就……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2069_1#3$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吕刻伊昂"]怎么办？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]你帮客人们把行李搬上船，我去拿个小东西。
[name="赞索斯"]让这位小姐往船舱靠里些坐，今天的风浪不大，行船应该稳当。特尔斐运河会善待每一位善良的客人。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]等送完她过河，我们再去主渡口，去会会那个萨尔贡的大使……可不能辜负了里底娅理事官的好意。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2069_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="吕刻伊昂"]我陪您，赞索斯老师。我得看住您。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="赞索斯"]……先帮客人搬行李吧。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",posfrom="0,0",posto="200,0",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="0,0",posto="200,0",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1.5)]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]……完全没有听我说话。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="米奥"]（小声）你又抓错重点了，他们分明是和你有仇啊！
[name="米奥"]（小声）你现在加入哥伦比亚国籍还来得及，可千万别——
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_dragsofa",volume=0.6,channel="1")]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[stopsound(channel="1")]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]欸，麻烦两位小心点，这可是很重要的东西。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral",volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="0,0",posto="200,0",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1.5)]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[multiline(name="米奥")]喂——你——
[multiline(name="米奥")]唉，先上船吧。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="27_g24_cloudy_sea",screenadapt="coverall",  xScale=1.05, yScale=1.05,block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=0.5, ystrength=0.5, vibrato=1, randomness=1, fadeout=false, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_sea",loop=true,channel="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赞索斯"]什么东西，这么重？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]是……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="米奥"]是货物。我们从蓝卡坞运过来的电影角色模型，里面甚至包括了新上映的《杜邦夫人》里的角色，打算在你们这儿倒卖。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4166_varkis_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赞索斯"]可是雅赛努斯一家电影院都没有。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1482_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#5$1",focus="l")]
[name="米奥"]那正好。好的推销员当然是要去光脚的地方卖鞋。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4056_titi_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="缇缇"]摆渡人先生，您刚刚说，“特尔斐运河会善待每一位善良的客人”？
[Dialog]
